steps.title: Gemma hears the diner
steps.reasoning: One call transcribes the audio and extracts the request. The model resolves 'without the fish sauce' against the dish it just heard named.

result.utterance: I have a tree nut allergy. Is the gnocchis pesto vegan safe for me?

steps.title: The label decides — Gnocchis pesto vegan
steps.reasoning: Symphony trays arrive sealed and reheated. What is in them is what the manufacturer printed, and nothing can be left out at the pass.

vegan_misreads: The pesto is made with pine nuts — pignons de pin — and pine nuts are tree nuts. They are printed in the ingredient list but not in bold, so a diner checking the bold allergen text will not see them. The dish is also sold as vegan, which describes animal products and says nothing about nuts. The nuts are blended into the sauce before the tray is sealed, so there is no version of this plat without them.

steps.title: Refuse rather than guess
steps.reasoning: The ingredient is in the tray. It cannot be removed from a sealed dish, so the answer is no — and if the label never bolded it, the diner would not have found it by reading carefully.
steps.forced_by: an ingredient the diner must avoid is on the label but not in the bold allergen text

steps.title: Gemma explains it in the diner's language (en)
steps.reasoning: The verdict was fixed before this ran. Gemma's job is to say it clearly and give the reason, not to reach it.

explanation: We cannot serve this as requested. The label lists pignons de pin (pine nuts). It is not in the bold allergen text, which is why it is easy to miss.  Made in a workshop that also handles: gluten, celery, mustard, peanuts, fish, eggs, soya, milk, tree nuts, sesame. Please speak to a member of staff before ordering.
